events.text: The service began using diesel multiple units from Friedrichstraße station to Wien Franz-Josefs-Bahnhof.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The service began on 13 January 1957 using diesel multiple units

events.text: The FDt trains had already begun running between Berlin and Prague.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The FDt trains had already begun running between Berlin and Prague in December 1950

events.text: The connection was upgraded as Expresszug (Ext 54/55).
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1959 the connection was upgraded as Expresszug ( Ext 54/55 )

events.text: The railcars had first and second class sections.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From December 1957 the railcars had first and second class sections

events.text: Domestic travel within Czechoslovakia was for some years completely forbidden during Normalization.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the period of Normalization from 1969 onwards , domestic travel within Czechoslovakia was for some years completely forbidden

events.text: Construction at the Franz-Josefs-Bahnhof made Wien Mitte station the terminus.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1975 , construction at the Franz-Josefs-Bahnhof made Wien Mitte station the terminus
